outputs.explanation: Panel A is a spatial transcriptomics cluster micrograph, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows H&E micrographs with manual region annotations, not a quantitative plot.
Panel C shows H&E micrographs and spatial gene expression overlay images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D consists of GSEA enrichment line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data points.

Panel E is a bar graph of log2 fold-change values per gene derived from differential expression testing (Wilcoxon rank-sum across many spatial spots), representing a single computed statistic per gene rather than a mean of a small number of individual replicate measurements, so overlaying individual data points is not applicable.
